dedupe_keys.name: supporting data for rainfall to reliability climate impacts on ghana s volta hydropower cascade

description: Supporting data for "Rainfall to Reliability: Climate Impacts on Ghana's Volta Hydropower Cascade" is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Processed data supporting the study. The archive contains the catchment-averaged inflow series (historical 1985-2014 and projected) for the Akosombo, Kpong and Bui catchments under five CMIP6 models and the SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5 scenarios; the reservoir and generation model outputs (firm power, capacity factor and spill); the grid-adequacy and energy-security results; and the observed-versus-simulated discharge ... Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are hydropower, Volta Basin, Ghana, CMIP6, climate change impacts. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
